description: The largest holders of an ERC-20 token on Base, ranked, with balance, percent of supply and wallet/contract/burn type, read straight from the chain. Top 1/5/10 concentration (burns excluded), a wallets-only share, burned percent and a low-to-very-high level. For tokens whose whole transfer history fits (most new and small tokens) the list and holder count are exact; otherwise coverage is reported. Not charged for invalid input. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

limit.description: How many holders to list, 1 to 50 (default 10).

name: token_holders
title: Top holders of a Base token and how concentrated its supply is
